summary: First-iteration end-to-end validation of ServicePro (FastAPI + Expo/RN). Backend: 17/18 pytest passing (single failure is a case-sensitivity issue in the test itself, not a product bug — backend correctly lowercases emails). Frontend: all critical mobile flows verified in Expo web preview at mobile viewport (390x844): onboarding, provider login → Provider Dashboard with subscription banner + stats + rating card + recent bookings, client registration → Client Home with categories/chip-filter/top-rated/provider list, Provider Detail with rating/rate cards/reviews/sticky CTA, full Booking flow with date scroller/time chips/rate toggle/estimated total → success screen. Dark navy + gold design renders professionally. Subscription/pay endpoint (mocked) works end-to-end and flips status to 'active'.

issues: Heading text 'Create account' and primary button share the same label — this required using .last selector in Playwright but is a minor test-authoring concern, not a UX bug.

action_items: None blocking. Optionally add testID attributes to key interactive components (Sign in, Create account button, category chips, provider card, Request Booking, Confirm) to make future UI regression tests more robust.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('startup') which is deprecated in FastAPI — consider migrating to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
compute_subscription assumes 30-day months; acceptable for MVP but note calendar-month drift for long-lived accounts.
Seed endpoint is publicly exposed (POST /api/seed). Idempotent but should be guarded/removed for production.
Payment endpoint /api/subscription/pay is MOCKED — no real gateway integration (as declared).
server.py is a single ~560-line file; splitting into routers (auth/providers/bookings/reviews) would help maintainability past MVP.
seed_data_creation: Registered a few TEST_ clients via /api/auth/register and one UI-created client; also produced 1 confirmed→completed booking with 5-star review on provider1 (Ahmed Boumediene). Subscription was toggled to 'active' for provider1 via mocked /api/subscription/pay.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Seeded via POST /api/seed. Provider1 has been paid (subscription 'active') and has 1 review. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_servicepro_api.py for regression; note test_me currently uses mixed-case email — either lowercase the fixture email or update the assertion.
rca_of_issue: test_me failure RCA: backend normalises email to lowercase at register (email = body.email.lower()); test compared response against the original mixed-case fixture value. Product behaviour is correct; test assertion should compare against email.lower(). Not fixed to avoid masking; documented instead.
